edits.before: Q-farm and nothing else — your level 1 is among the worst mid. Give CS you can't Q safely and smile about it.
edits.after: His Wild Cards and Blue Card outrange your 600-range Q — farm what you can safely and give the rest happily.

edits.before: Still surviving. Q on cooldown when free, pool saved for the jungler you haven't seen yet.
edits.after: Ranged card poke keeps chipping you and you cannot answer — Q on cooldown, pool held for ganks.

edits.before: E charges join the pattern: Q-E wave contact trades start mattering. Health is your mana — spend like an accountant.
edits.after: Gold Card gank setup is now his kill plan — track his jungler, hug your side, and trade after Wild Cards whiffs.

edits.before: The crimson rush timing — Q empowers every third-ish cast and the sustain war starts tilting your way.
edits.after: Stacked Transfusion now out-heals his card poke — his mana dips first and you seize control of the wave.

edits.before: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: Q-E-R-E with ignite kills most mids who thought they were winning.
edits.after: Hemoplague plus pool gives you an all-in and a Gold Card dodge he cannot answer — locally the lane is yours.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: Riftmaker sustain blanks his Wild Cards chip entirely — he pivots to Destiny roams because the lane is lost.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Sanguine Pool like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: Pick a Card is only 6s, but the locked gold card is his one stun — back off when it glows yellow, then trade into the gap. Wild Cards is 6s and 60+ mana a cast; your Q is free. Destiny is 170s early — while it is down he cannot roam, so you shove for free.

edits.before: The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — it is an auto-reset, so his wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: After the gold-card auto and Wild Cards he has six seconds of nothing — step in, Q-E, and walk out unanswered.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: At half HP with W down, one Gold Card holds you for the full jungler follow-up — back off until the 28-second timer ends.
